text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign currencies went on sale on Monday in most Bosnian business banks following a recent central bank decision allowing purchases up to the equivalent of 1,000 German marks.
- The Bosnian National soccer team departs for the town of Manaus in Brazil to play a friendly against four-time world champion National team of Brazil next Wednesday.
- Haris Silajdzic, newly-elected Bosnian co-Prime Minister, says the development of economy will be a key to the reintegration of the country.

- I spoke to police and told them to find a proper way to stop these evictions, Ivan Prskalo, mayor of the Croat held part of the bitterly divided Bosnian town of Mostar says after a new wave of evictions of Moslems from the town.
